artifact: CityMETER Restaurants — 3D-first, subdistrict-first restaurant density map
locationIntelligenceProfile: not applied — restaurant observations are not a supply-capacity, demand or market measure; the product uses base analytical families only

fontRoles.dataAndMetrics: JetBrains Mono 400; tabular numerals; normal tracking
fontRoles.navigation: Material Symbols Rounded approved nav-7 subset; FILL 0 / wght 300 / GRAD 0 / opsz 24
fontRoles.pictograms: Material Symbols Rounded 8-glyph pictogram subset reused byte-for-byte from Luxury Brands 0.5 (owner test exception 2026-10-22)

colors.applied: assets/theme.css — foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, dataState (noData, zero), categorical series 1–10 (landometer-series-10-v8 soft fill + ink), count classes (province swatches), basemap-only tokens
colors.analytical: js/scales.js — density.area (scaleVersion 554812a7c19107b3a9b8658ba541fc8e13519cb19708e885a425f32d5b30f101), count (4ff5c1fb4be71ecd13c48685b38371b528bcd4ce369ce964a75354c2eb4d0980), price (a4fcda655f3e10c43e8deab212d7da20335392a87c823a390ab81a69d38cfccc); exact 41-sample LUTs; identical HEX on both themes
colors.categorical: js/cues.js — food-type group id → series 1–10 with the LDS shape cue (circle, square, triangle, diamond, cross, star, hexagon, ring, dash, plus)
colors.reportedDifference: LDS analytical scale records list dark noData #3B4849 / zeroOutline #BAC6C0, while machine.tokens.dataState (referenced by the EVID-05 treatments) lists dark #404844 / #93A398; the map follows the EVID-05 treatment (dataState) and the difference is reported to the owner
colors.notDistributed: full LDS library, other analytical families, Location Intelligence profile scales

firstAha: combined restaurants per km² of the three densest แขวง/ตำบล (≥ 30 rows) against the coverage baseline, computed per selection; the map opens in the 3D city preset with those three areas focused automatically and the rest quiet

focusAndQuiet.implementation: app.js focus modes (auto/explicit/none) and row scopes (scopeRows/baseRows/rows); map-layers.js filled/quiet feature-state; pins.js cue symbols vs grey context dots; massing.js quiet city tier vs rounded focus tier; camera.js presets; venue-xray.js keeps the venue solid visible; provinces.js frames below zoom 8.5

geometryAndMetricContract: one observation per symbol; membership by the source subdistrict code; density = rows ÷ production km²; combined density Σ/Σ; coordinates are MVT display positions (z10, 9.55 m) and never upgraded
accessibility: visible focus on every control including pins, area labels and chart marks
keyboard pin tour (arrow keys) at detail zoom, excluding quiet context dots
roving tablist for the chart views
table equivalent for every map view
categorical shape cues beside colour; text labels in every legend and list
empty, map-failure and load-error paths with actions

validation.renderedHarness: Playwright + MapLibre 5.6.2 from the npm package + stub TileJSON (empty basemap tiles except harness building tiles for the test areas: CityMETER production footprints in the OpenMapTiles building schema); 1440×900, 1180×760 and 390×844; light and dark
validation.scope: Applied LDS values, fonts and actual rendered interfaces. No blanket LDS, CVD, native-device or market-completeness claim.

layoutContract.chartTray: collapsible bottom overlay, 52 px collapsed, 360 px / ≤58% open
layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, bottom sheet ≤ 64dvh with sticky close, compact Aha card on the map while the sheet is closed, only focus labels on the map

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet with --basemap-* tokens; no hosted style URL
mapContract.choropleth: density.area, five equal-interval classes over (0, rounded max], [lower, upper) with the last closed, precision by magnitude; opacity 1 beneath the basemap's first line layer; off at zoom ≥ 14.5; EVID-05 measured / measured_zero (lowest class + 2 px zero outline) / no_data (135° hatch on dataState.noData + border.emphasis) / out_of_scope (not drawn)
mapContract.provinces: count family per province frame below zoom 8.5, outlines to zoom 12, ink-chip labels to zoom 9, panel list; drill-down into the จังหวัด filter
mapContract.symbols: focus rows as cue icons (series fill + shape, marker-stroke outline) in a symbol layer, never clustered; context rows as grey circles; HTML pins with logos from zoom 15.5 (≤ 320 pins, ≤ 250 logos)
mapContract.labels: ink chips for the focus/selection, light chips for the rest (≤ 12 desktop, none on a phone in focus mode); swatch = the area's class colour; value = ร้าน/ตร.กม.
mapContract.venues: host buildings of 25 venue candidates (exact name match with the Luxury Brands host set) in map.activeLayer, drawn only at venue level; x-ray keeps them visible and clickable
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ › แขวง/ตำบล with production codes and /D/ /S/ deep links; venue mode ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › venue; store is the heading

brandIdentity.sources: 155 chain logo files and 157 venue logo files from the research logo manifest; original bytes, sha256-checked; backplate from the registry
brandIdentity.fallback: visible names and accessible labels retained; logos are identity, not a metric, endorsement or branch verification

chartContract.density: sorted bars, density class colour, value beside the bar; count bars when no area reaches the eligibility threshold
chartContract.matrix: table-layout fixed with a colgroup; every cell the same size; cell tint = count class; column headers carry the series cue
chartContract.price: 100% stacked bars of priced rows in the price family; unspecified counted beside the bar

copy: short natural Thai: ร้าน / เครือร้าน / สถานที่ / แขวง·ตำบล / เขต·อำเภอ; units on every number; provenance line (dataset · source · date · boundary) at the end of every panel view

registerAndLand.register: national chain register (data/chains.json) on the same map as the snapshot (owner 2026-10-28 “แสดงร่วมกัน”): every outlet with a coordinate as a small location pin (SDF icon; a shape outside the ten restaurant cue shapes) from zoom 11 under the restaurant symbols, hidden or shown with the map chip ‘ร้านเครือ’ (?rdots=0); a register view (chains/chain/company/outlet) draws its selection at every zoom with logos from zoom 15 while the snapshot stays as quiet context (frames, context dots, massing, buildings; no province counts over the selection); LDS map data role (--map-active-layer, halo --map-marker-halo, selected --map-selected-stroke); an outlet opens with its Land building in the data colour; never summed with the snapshot
registerAndLand.land: Land host view (shopping centres, hotels, offices): the host building drawn in the data colour at venue level (x-ray, eye camera); LOD2 building parts drawn when the registry has them, the footprint as an outline; in-vs-around food types table (counts + column share, series cue + label per row)
registerAndLand.switch: no data-set tabs since 0.3.1: one map and one panel flow; the register directory opens from the overview, area and Land sections and keeps its own search (names only)
